themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants in housing, welfare, and employment. This theme reflects a coordinated effort to institutionalize 'national preference' in domestic legislation, with parallel legislative proposals in Spain, Italy, Sweden, and Norway.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s declining approval amid internal strife
themes.blurb: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces plummeting approval ratings and escalating internal conflicts, with key allies like Patricia Bullrich publicly opposing his judicial nominations. This theme resonates in Spain and Italy, where far-right parties monitor Milei's struggles as a cautionary tale for their own governance ambitions.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties are making significant inroads in local elections across Germany, Italy, and Spain, often leveraging anti-immigration and anti-establishment rhetoric. These gains signal a broader shift in European political landscapes, with mainstream parties struggling to counter the far-right surge.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders in the US, Argentina, and Italy are aligning with Israel in the ongoing Middle East conflicts, often framing their support as a defense of Western civilization. This theme reflects a broader transnational trend of far-right solidarity with Israel, contrasting with left-wing critiques of Israeli policies.
